bagPolicy.summary: Unipol Forum does not publish a universal bag-size limit in its current access rules. Motorcycle helmets and potentially dangerous items are prohibited, and event promoters may impose additional restrictions.
bagPolicy.note: Check the promoter's event-specific restrictions before arrival.

parking.note: Unipol Forum offers ample parking near the venue, with Park B being a notable option. Electric car charging is available at a hub in front of the Repower Theatre. Parking fees during events start from €10.

rideshare.note: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Unipol Forum. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.note: Inside the Unipol Forum, visitors can enjoy a variety of food and drink options, including several bars and a large food court. Specific details about the offerings are not provided.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Unipol Forum has reserved spaces and platforms for guests with disabilities, with dedicated, clearly marked routes. Accessible tickets are handled by each event's organizer, so contact the organizer linked on the event page. For more information, email accessibilita.milano@forumnet.it.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Unipol Forum's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Unipol Forum. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Unipol Forum. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
